data.caption:
Mumbai walo ke liye CNG ka ek aur jhatka! ⛽

• CNG hui 1.50 rupye mehngi
• Prati kilo daam badhakar hue 91.50 rupye

Aise hi daam badhte rahe toh auto wale rocket kharid lenge!

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo hamesha auto ka bhada kam karwata hai! 👇
